review:
Wild Chicago is a 1920s gangster slot where an animal mob, led by a crocodile boss, fights over the city. It's a 10-line game where the crocodile is the wild and doubles every win it completes.

Three or more scatters award 15 free spins, and all free spins wins are tripled. Three or more scatters during the round retrigger it. That gives a wild win in the bonus a combined 6x boost. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 4,684x maximum, and the 97.1% RTP is excellent. Free spins arrive about once every 262 spins. It's the same structure as Savage Buffalo Spirit, with a crime-movie theme.
